params.1273: Mine some copper in the mining spot to the south-east of Lumbridge Swamp.
params.1274: Acquire a pickaxe (you can get one free from Bob's Brilliant Axes).
params.1275: Follow the road south out of Lumbridge.
params.1276: Keep following the road south, through the graveyard and along the coast until you reach the mining spot.
params.1277: Examine the rocks to discover which one holds copper and then mine it to gain some copper ore.
params.1278: Mining copper ore will give you 17.5 experience in the Mining skill.
params.1279: It is most efficient to fill half your inventory with copper and the other half with tin ore, for making bronze later.
params.1292: This Beginner Task is part of the Lumbridge set.
